query: One such pathway, the integrated stress response (ISR), is triggered when one of four stress-sensing kinases becomes active: (1) heme-regulated inhibitor kinase (HRI) is activated by oxidative stress, such as arsenite; (2) protein kinase R (PKR) is activated by viral infections; (3) PKR-like endoplasmic reticulum kinase (PERK) is induced when unfolded proteins accumulate (proteotoxic stress) and when the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) becomes stressed; and (4) general control non-depressible 2 (GCN2) is induced in poor nutrient conditions, particularly amino acid deprivation (Costa-Mattioli and Walter, 2020; El-Naggar and Sorensen, 2018).
